title: Write test article generator for development and benchmarking
description:
Write a small Rust binary or script (tools/gen_articles/) that generates N synthetic Usenet articles (configurable group, size range, date range) in mbox format to stdout or a file. Used to seed test environments and run benchmarks without real article data. Artifact: tools/gen_articles/src/main.rs (standalone binary, not part of main workspace) or scripts/gen_articles.py.

Acceptance: generates valid RFC 5536 articles; each article has unique Message-ID; groups and date ranges configurable; 10,000 articles generated in under 5 seconds; output is valid mbox format
